1:
Seventeen thousand years of silence is about to break.

Lukas was raised to serve the Spire — until the night he carried a dying stranger through the Midnight Court and learned the order he serves devours the very people it claims to protect. Hunted by the Auditor's Messengers and haunted by memories that aren't his, he must cross ash-choked warrens, forge a brotherhood of outcasts, and face the Chimera's trial.

But some destinies don't bend. They twist.

Book One of the Quillan-Ronin Saga.
2:
The Spire has fallen. What rises in its place is worse.

As rival powers carve up the corpse of the old order, Lukas must turn a brotherhood of survivors into something that can hold a city — while the Rift widens and something vast presses against the walls of the world. Alliances will be bought in blood. Promises will be kept at impossible prices.

Power doesn't corrupt. It reveals.

Book Two of the Quillan-Ronin Saga.
3:
Every world has a breaking point. Aethoria just found hers.

The multi-versal war has come home: Vaelthorne war machines darken the skies, the dead walk the wheat fields, and Lukas must hold together an alliance of humans, hybrids, and things with no name — while Fenris walks alone into the Rift carrying the one weapon that can end it.

Some battles are fought for victory. This one is fought for morning.

Book Three of the Quillan-Ronin Saga.
4:
Empires don't fall in battle. They fall in ledgers.

In the smoking aftermath, the real war begins: who writes the peace, who counts the dead, and who decides what the seventeen thousand cycles of the Auditor were for. Lukas wants rest. Aethoria wants a reckoning. And beneath the rebuilding, something patient is still counting.

The true resolution was never going to be clean.

Book Four of the Quillan-Ronin Saga.
5:
Every legend has a side no one tells. This is his.

While Lukas carried the war, Fenris carried the silence — the hunts, the bargains, the price of walking into the dark so others could stand in the light. From the wheat fields of Oakhaven to the heart of the Rift itself: the saga as only the Wolfheart could tell it.

Your scars are the map to tomorrow.

A companion volume to the Quillan-Ronin Saga.
